askToolRounds.description: The most rounds of one Ask box question that may call tools, before one last round without; 0 or unset is 5 (D-208)

askToolCalls.description: The most tool calls one Ask box question runs in all; 0 or unset is 10 (D-208)

askOutputTokens.description: The most output tokens the model may write for one Ask box question, all its calls together; 0 or unset is 800 (D-208)

askDeadline.description: The longest one Ask box question may take, from 10s to 5m; unset is 2m (D-208)

turnstileSiteKey.description: The public key of the Cloudflare Turnstile widget made for the host of the Ask box; set together with turnstileVerifyUrl to put the check in front of the model of the Ask box (D-208), unset for none

turnstileVerifyUrl.description: The siteverify URL of Cloudflare, https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify; the install shows its host and the grant approves it

clientEvents.description: Whether the pages report a fixed set of events about themselves (the person check states and error codes, script errors, failed requests, the browser family and version) to the UI log and metrics, never anything typed (D-227); unset is true
